title: Prepositions
content:
Definition

English: Prepositions are words that show the relationship of a noun or pronoun to another word, indicating position, direction, time, or manner.
Hindi: Sambandh suchak shabd wo shabd hote hain jo sangya ya sarvanam ka doosre shabd ke saath sambandh darshate hain, sthan, disha, samay, ya tareeka batate hain.

They link elements in a sentence to clarify relationships.
Ye vakya ke tatvon ko jodkar sambandh spasht karte hain.

Example: The book is on the table.
Hindi: Kitaab mez par hai.

title: Types of Prepositions
content:
Explanation

English: Prepositions are categorized by their function: time, place, direction, manner, and others.
Hindi: Sambandh suchak shabd apne karya ke adhaar par vibhajit hote hain: samay, sthan, disha, tareeka, aur anya.

Main Types

  • Time: Indicate when something happens (e.g., at, on, in).
  • Place: Show location or position (e.g., in, on, at).
  • Direction: Indicate movement or destination (e.g., to, towards, into).
  • Manner: Show how something is done (e.g., with, by).
  • Other: Indicate cause, purpose, or association (e.g., for, of).
Example: She arrived at noon (time), sits on the chair (place), and walked to the park (direction).
Hindi: Woh dopahar mein aayi (samay), kursi par baithi (sthan), aur park tak chali (disha).

title: Prepositions of Time
content:
Use

English: Prepositions of time indicate when something happens, such as specific times, days, or periods.
Hindi: Samay ke sambandh suchak shabd batate hain ki koi ghatna kab hoti hai, jaise vishesh samay, din, ya avadhi.

Common Prepositions

  • At: Specific times (e.g., at 5 p.m.).
  • On: Days or dates (e.g., on Monday).
  • In: Longer periods (e.g., in January, in 2023).
Example: We meet at midnight on Friday in summer.
Hindi: Hum mein adhi raat ko Shukravaar par garmi mein milte hain.

title: Prepositions of Place
content:
Use

English: Prepositions of place show where something is located or positioned.
Hindi: Sthan ke sambandh suchak shabd batate hain ki koi cheez kahan sthit hai ya rakhi hai.

Common Prepositions

  • At: Specific points (e.g., at the door).
  • On: Surfaces or public transport (e.g., on the table).
  • In: Enclosed spaces or larger areas (e.g., in the room).
Example: The cat is in the box, on the mat, or at the window.
Hindi: Billi mein dibbe mein, par chatai par, ya khidki ke paas hai.

title: Prepositions of Direction
content:
Use

English: Prepositions of direction indicate movement toward a place or destination.
Hindi: Disha ke sambandh suchak shabd kisi sthan ya gantavya ki taraf gati darshate hain.

Common Prepositions

  • To: Toward a destination (e.g., to school).
  • Towards: In the direction of (e.g., towards the park).
  • Into: Movement inside (e.g., into the house).
Example: She walked to the store and ran towards the park.
Hindi: Woh dukaan tak chali aur park ki or daudi.

title: Prepositions of Manner
content:
Use

English: Prepositions of manner show how an action is performed.
Hindi: Tareeke ke sambandh suchak shabd batate hain ki koi karya kaise kiya gaya.

Common Prepositions

  • With: Using a tool or manner (e.g., with a pen).
  • By: Method or means (e.g., by car).
Example: He wrote with a pencil by hand.
Hindi: Usne pencil se haath se likha.

title: Other Prepositions
content:
Use

English: Prepositions like 'for,' 'of,' 'about,' and 'from' indicate purpose, possession, topic, or origin.
Hindi: Sambandh suchak shabd jaise 'ke liye,' 'ka,' 'ke bare mein,' aur 'se' uddeshya, swaamitva, vishay, ya utpatti darshate hain.

Example: This gift is for you, from John, about love.
Hindi: Yeh uphaar ke liye tumhare, John se, pyar ke bare mein hai.

title: Prepositional Phrases
content:
Definition

English: A prepositional phrase consists of a preposition, its object, and any modifiers, acting as an adjective or adverb.
Hindi: Sambandh suchak vakyansh mein ek sambandh suchak shabd, uska karma, aur koi sanshodhak hote hain, jo visheshan ya kriya visheshan ke roop mein kaam karte hain.

Use

Provides additional details about time, place, or manner.
Samay, sthan, ya tareeke ke bare mein atirikt jankari deta hai.

Example: She sat on the wooden bench.
Hindi: Woh lakdi ki bench par baithi.

title: Common Challenges with Prepositions
content:
Explanation

English: Prepositions can be tricky due to exceptions and context-specific usage (e.g., 'in' vs. 'on' for time/place). Some verbs require specific prepositions.
Hindi: Sambandh suchak shabd mushkil ho sakte hain kyunki unke apvad aur sandarbh-vishesh prayog hote hain (jaise, 'mein' banam 'par'). Kuch kriyayen vishesh sambandh suchak mangti hain.

Example: Depend on (not 'in'). Arrive at a place, but in a city.
Hindi: Nirbhar par (nahi 'mein'). Sthan par pahunchna, lekin shehar mein.
